summary: Frontend-only retest of the UI login flow (autofill fix). CONFIRMED: /login renders with email/password prefilled exactly as jbenterpriises01@gmail.com / Talbros@2026 (12 chars); clicking login-submit-button returns POST /api/auth/login 200 and lands on [data-testid=dashboard-page] with NO login-error. Session persists after full page reload (GET /api/auth/me 200 via httpOnly cookie). Wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' (401), Fill button repopulates correct creds + clears error, subsequent Sign in succeeds. Logout returns to /login (POST /api/auth/logout 200) and visiting /recipients unauthenticated redirects to /login (/auth/me 401). Dashboard metric cards render and sidebar navigation (recipients <-> dashboard) works. No console errors, no failing API calls observed.

design_issues.screen: Recipients / Settings / Reports / CreateSimulation / SimulationHistory / AuditLogs
issues: Native HTML <select> elements are used instead of shadcn Select components (e.g. dept-filter, sim-mode-select, retention-select) - inconsistent look with the dark themed UI
All metric values are 0 / 'No data available' - empty state only (expected with no seeded simulations), verify with seed data if a populated demo is desired

action_items: Optional cleanup before handoff to the real user: remove hardcoded prefilled password in Login.jsx state and the plaintext credentials hint block (security exposure - credentials visible to anyone loading /login). Keep autoComplete=off/new-password.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx hardcodes admin email+password in component state and displays them in the DOM; acceptable as a temporary autofill workaround but must not ship to production.
Native <select> used across 8+ pages while shadcn/ui is available - consider standardizing.
test_credentials: jbenterpriises01@gmail.com / Talbros@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - verified working via UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI login is fully working end-to-end on the public URL; cookies are first-party so session persists across reload. One intentional failed login was performed (lockout counter is 5/15min, so at most 1 attempt consumed for this ip+email). If further failed-login testing is needed, be aware of the lockout. Remaining untested areas: CRUD flows for simulations, landing pages, forms, senders, sandbox, reports export.
rca_of_the_issue: Original user-reported failure was browser password autofill overwriting the password field. Fix (prefilled state + autoComplete=new-password/off + Fill button) verified effective in a clean automated browser; login now reaches the dashboard.
